server.name: xyz.rillora/rillora
server.description: Read selected digital-legacy matters and check missing information. OAuth and item consent required.
server.title: Rillora

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.access: Only explicitly selected matter summaries and optional common missing-field names; access can be revoked in Rillora.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.authentication: Pre-registered public OAuth clients; use the matching client ID in the installation guide. Dynamic client registration is not enabled.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.consumerAcceptance: Codex authorization, model tool calls and revocation verified against the production endpoint. Other consumer products and their directory approvals are tracked separately.
